name: vibesdk-sandbox-controlplane
description: HTTP control-plane server that runs inside the AWS sandbox container (Fargate task) and implements the operations aws/sandbox-contract's SandboxServiceClient interface needs -- the AWS replacement for the proprietary control-plane baked into cloudflare/sandbox's base image. Talks to container/cli-tools.ts (monitor-cli, reused unmodified from the Cloudflare-era container) for process/error/log management, and does file I/O and command execution directly.
